prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied isolated grass prop sprite. Correct ONLY the basal silhouette: EVERY grass blade and leaf tip must stay ABOVE the TRUE ROOT CONTACT LINE. Currently a few drooping blades extend below the cut basal stem origin; lift and curve them upward instead. Make the compact basal stem origin the single LOWEST point of the actual plant silhouette, like a fan opening UPWARD from its base. At least30 source pixels vertical clearance between all lateral leaf tips and the root contact line. Do not move the declared root down as a workaround. No leaf, shadow, halo, soil or object may extend below the actual basal stem contact. Keep the original natural realistic grass materials, upper-left lighting and the single small0.5m high1m wide Dali1093 plant-prop scale. Keep this the LOW COMPACT DENSE grass tuft variant; shorter blades, compact rounded fan, natural restrained green with a few straw tips. Do not add separate grass clumps, dirt, sod mat, pot, mound, scenery, text, border or watermark. Retain full crown and complete leaf tips with generous transparent margin. TRUE transparent RGBA, transparent leaf gaps, absolutely no cast/contact shadow or backdrop. The lower quarter of the output is completely alpha0.

rejections.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate ONE isolated botanical PROP SPRITE for a realistic ancient Dali kingdom1093 isometric game. Botanical silhouette is an original regional impression, not a claim of exact historical species. True transparent RGBA image; empty background and leaf gaps must be alpha0. Camera orthographic yaw45 degrees and elevation30 degrees, natural three-dimensional plant volume, upright stem. Realistic leaves and bark with muted natural color and fine material texture, softly lit from SCREEN UPPER LEFT. No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no ambient halo, no ground patch, no soil ball, no dirt, no stone base, no planter, no pot, no landscape, no architecture, no text, no letters, no watermarks, no people, no modern objects. Complete crown and all leaf tips must stay fully inside canvas with generous15% clear transparent margin. Plant is rooted at ONE small central origin on a horizontal contact line near lower-middle of canvas; bottom trunk/stems stop cleanly at the ground contact line, no exposed roots, soil or root ball, nothing and NO shadow extends below that line. This is one isolated plant object, not a scene or a cluster of separate plants. The lower quarter of the image is entirely transparent. ONE LOW TUFT of native-looking grass, only0.5m high and around1m wide, blades rise from one compact central basal origin, short slender dull-green blades forming a low compact fan, a few dry straw tips, transparent space between individual blades. No dirt mound, no sod mat or lawn tile.
